tests.name: picks the directory that parents the most registered projects
tests.evidence: Registry with majority local projects and temp/outlier entries selects literal shared project root.

tests.name: returns null when the registry has no usable entries
tests.evidence: Registry containing only temp entries returns null common root.

tests.name: resolves via root_id + rel_path against this machine's root
tests.evidence: Root/relative project mapping resolves exact machine-local path.

tests.name: prefers a per-machine override over the root resolution
tests.evidence: Machine override wins over competing root-derived path.

tests.name: returns null when the project's root isn't configured on this machine
tests.evidence: Unconfigured project root returns null path.

tests.name: returns null for an unknown project
tests.evidence: Unknown project returns null path.

tests.name: reports provenance per project
tests.evidence: Mixed projects expose literal root/override/none provenance and exactly one unresolved path.

tests.name: stores machine-independent root_id+rel_path when path is under a root
tests.evidence: Recording under-root path persists exact root_id/rel_path with no redundant override.

tests.name: stores a per-machine override when path is outside every root
tests.evidence: Outside-root recording persists literal override path and resolves it back.

tests.name: clears a redundant override once a project moves under a root
tests.evidence: Moving project under configured root removes previously stored machine override.

tests.name: copies a consistent brain (with data) to the target
tests.evidence: Real centralized DB copy opens and contains literal seeded project name and memory title.

tests.name: refuses to overwrite an existing target without --force
tests.evidence: Repeated target without force rejects with already-exists error.

tests.name: overwrites with force
tests.evidence: Forced overwrite only resolves truthy against unchanged source; no replacement data is checked.
tests.mutationSuggestion: When force=true and target exists, return success without copying source.

tests.name: throws when the source brain is missing
tests.evidence: Missing source rejects with No local brain error.

tests.name: oversized body → 413
tests.evidence: A real loopback POST exceeds configured 1024-byte cap and receives literal HTTP 413.

tests.name: never-completing body → 408
tests.evidence: An unfinished real HTTP request exceeds the 100ms body deadline and receives literal HTTP 408 before a 2s guard.

tests.name: disallowed Origin → 403
tests.evidence: An evil.example Origin receives literal HTTP 403 from the real HTTP server.

tests.name: no Origin header → not 403
tests.evidence: The no-Origin request only checks status is not 403; any other failure is accepted.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Return HTTP 500 for requests without Origin after the origin check.

tests.name: allowlisted Origin → not 403
tests.evidence: An allowlisted Origin only checks not-403 and does not prove a successful MCP response.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Return HTTP 500 whenever the supplied Origin is allowlisted.

tests.name: serves /health
tests.evidence: The real health endpoint returns success and literal status ok.

tests.name: a client can connect and list tools over HTTP
tests.evidence: An SDK client initializes through the real HTTP transport and lists the ping tool.

tests.name: tracks concurrent sessions independently
tests.evidence: Two connected clients increase the health session count to two; no operation checks independent session lifecycle.

tests.name: 404s unknown paths
tests.evidence: A real request to an unknown route receives literal HTTP 404.

tests.name: returns 400 for a non-initialize POST without a session
tests.evidence: A tools/list request lacking a session receives literal HTTP 400.

tests.name: rejects requests without the bearer token
tests.evidence: A server configured with a bearer token rejects a real unauthenticated MCP request with HTTP 401.

tests.name: allows a client that presents the token
tests.evidence: A real SDK client using the configured bearer token connects and receives the ping tool.

tests.name: health probe is reachable without auth
tests.evidence: The health endpoint remains successful when bearer auth is configured and no authorization is supplied.

tests.name: emits zero stdout bytes even when DB app_version is older than pkg.version
tests.evidence: The child inherits worker GNOSYS_HOME instead of the seeded HOME DB, discards stderr, never proves readiness, and accepts empty stdout even after an immediate crash.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Exit serve immediately with code 1 before initializing the MCP transport; stdout remains empty.

tests.name: alive: directory with .gnosys/ subdir
tests.evidence: A real registered project directory with .gnosys is present only in alive, with dead and temp empty.

tests.name: dead: directory exists but no .gnosys/
tests.evidence: A real existing directory without .gnosys is returned in dead.

tests.name: dead: directory does not exist at all
tests.evidence: A nonexistent registered directory is returned in dead.

tests.name: temp: path under /tmp or /var/folders is classified as temp
tests.evidence: A real temporary directory from os.tmpdir is returned in temp.

tests.name: no registry → empty categories
tests.evidence: A missing registry produces three literal empty categories.

tests.name: with yes=true removes dead+temp and keeps alive
tests.evidence: Cleanup removes two stale registrations and persists exactly the single alive project path.

tests.name: dry-run (interactive=false, yes=false) does NOT write
tests.evidence: Dry-run reports one candidate removal and preserves the registry bytes exactly.

tests.name: no stale entries → no write, removed=0
tests.evidence: An alive-only registry reports removed=0, kept=1 and wrote=false.

tests.name: upgrade (patch): emits `upgraded` on stderr, NO MCP-restart block
tests.evidence: A child CLI against a DB stamped one patch older emits upgraded plus the literal version transition and omits restart MCP.

tests.name: upgrade (minor): emits MCP-restart block
tests.evidence: A child CLI against a DB stamped one minor older emits upgraded and restart MCP.

tests.name: downgrade: emits `reverted` and the unintentional hint
tests.evidence: A child CLI against a DB stamped newer emits reverted and the unintentional-downgrade hint.

tests.name: upgrade nag never writes to stdout
tests.evidence: A child CLI against a stale DB emits only the actual package version on stdout.

tests.name: dream.provider inherits defaultProvider when neither dream.provider nor llm.ollama is set
tests.evidence: Loading a real config with xai default and no dream or Ollama override produces dream.provider=xai.

tests.name: dream.provider stays ollama when user has an llm.ollama block (explicit opt-in)
tests.evidence: An explicit Ollama block preserves dream.provider=ollama despite an anthropic default.

tests.name: dream.provider is left alone when user explicitly set it (even to ollama)
tests.evidence: An explicit dream.provider=ollama survives an xai default.

tests.name: dream.provider takes the user's explicit value over inheritance
tests.evidence: An explicit dream.provider=groq survives an anthropic default.

tests.name: inheritance is skipped when defaultProvider is ollama (no change needed)
tests.evidence: An ollama default loads with literal dream.provider=ollama.

tests.name: top and bottom borders have identical printable widths
tests.evidence: Panel borders have matching widths and corner suffixes but no literal expected width or rendered text is checked.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Return a fixed two-line rounded empty box from Panel; top/bottom lengths and corners still match.

tests.name: ANSI in the title does not shift the right rule
tests.evidence: The ANSI-title check compares only first and last rendered widths; omitting the title or the entire panel also passes.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Return an empty string from Panel when its title contains an ANSI escape.

tests.name: very long titles fall back to a 1-char clamp instead of negative pad
tests.evidence: The long-title check proves only corner and dash suffixes, not the claimed one-character clamp.

tests.name: uses rounded glyphs + accent-dim border per design
tests.evidence: The design check asserts rounded glyph presence but never checks the claimed accent-dim border.

tests.name: removes a knowledge file and rebuilds the index (--json)
tests.evidence: Removal checks file absence and index-file presence, but never loads the rebuilt index or preserves another document.
tests.mutationSuggestion: After deleting the selected file, write an empty object as gnosys-index.json instead of rebuilding it.

tests.name: refuses to remove a path outside the knowledge directory
tests.evidence: Traversal outside knowledge root produces exit(1) and the literal refusal message.

tests.name: errors on a missing file
tests.evidence: A missing file produces exit(1) and literal File not found output.

tests.name: sample-index.json is valid and loadable
tests.evidence: loadIndex is called, but only version=1, nonempty documents and a self-consistent documentCount are asserted.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Replace loadIndex with a constant valid-looking index containing one unrelated document and documentCount=1.

tests.name: sample knowledge files have valid frontmatter
tests.evidence: The case parses fixture frontmatter with gray-matter and checks fixture fields; no application code is called.

tests.name: sample HTML pages exist and are valid
tests.evidence: The case only reads fixture HTML and checks file count and static markup; no application code is called.

tests.name: sample MDX files exist
tests.evidence: The case only counts three MDX fixture files; no application code is called.

tests.name: ingests markdown files and builds a searchable index
tests.evidence: The real index build/write/load/search pipeline yields five documents and an Agentic top hit for automation agents workflow.

tests.name: search respects category filter
tests.evidence: Filtered search results are checked only by a possibly empty loop and length<=all results.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Return [] whenever search receives a category option.

tests.name: search respects tag filter
tests.evidence: Tag-filtered search has no cardinality assertion; an empty result skips every assertion.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Return [] whenever search receives a tags option.

tests.name: getDocument retrieves specific document from built index
tests.evidence: The expected document title is read from the production-built index and compared with another production result instead of a fixture literal.
tests.action: Replace source/private-state checks with public behavior checks

tests.name: listDocuments filters by category on built index
tests.evidence: Category listing accepts an empty array because only length<=all and an empty-loop category check are asserted.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Return [] from listDocuments whenever a category option is supplied.

tests.name: extracts title and category from HTML content
tests.evidence: Real structured extraction of about-page HTML yields an About title and literal mapped company category.

tests.name: extracts category from URL patterns for blog posts
tests.evidence: Real extraction maps a matching blog URL to literal category blog.

tests.name: falls back to general category for unmatched URLs
tests.evidence: An unmatched URL maps to literal fallback category general.

tests.name: computes distinctive terms for each document
tests.evidence: TF-IDF is checked only for one nonempty <=10-entry list per document; wrong terms or weights pass.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Return the same single placeholder term with weight 1 for each document in computeTfIdf.

tests.name: automation doc gets automation-related terms
tests.evidence: Real TF-IDF for the automation document must include at least one literal domain term automation, agentic or workflow.

tests.name: MDX fixtures contain content that should be processable
tests.evidence: The MDX handling case only reads a nonempty fixture and calls no application parser.

tests.name: building index twice produces identical output
tests.evidence: Determinism compares only IDs and inverted-index keys, omitting document content and posting/score values despite claiming identical output.

tests.name: staticSearch.ts only imports from Node.js fs
tests.evidence: Bundle isolation is inferred from regexes over import source text, not from importing or using the shipped web entry.
tests.action: Replace source/private-state checks with public behavior checks

tests.name: staticSearch.ts has no import type that would pull runtime deps
tests.evidence: A source regex asserts zero relative runtime imports; it does not exercise the published module or native-dependency isolation.
tests.action: Replace source/private-state checks with public behavior checks

tests.name: extracts simple wikilinks

tests.name: extracts wikilinks with display text

tests.evidence: Link-free content produces an empty extracted-link array.

tests.name: includes source info
tests.evidence: Extracted links carry literal source path decisions/auth-decision.md and source title Auth Decision.

tests.name: resolves by title (case-insensitive)

tests.name: resolves by title case-insensitively
tests.evidence: Lowercase db choice resolves to literal ID db-choice.

tests.name: resolves by relative path

tests.name: resolves by filename without extension
tests.evidence: The extensionless filename three-layers resolves to literal ID three-layers.

tests.name: resolves by id
tests.evidence: The id lookup uses auth-decision, also the fixture basename, so resolveLink returns through the earlier filename branch and never exercises ID fallback.

tests.name: returns null for non-existent target
tests.evidence: An unknown target produces literal null.

tests.name: builds graph with correct link counts
tests.evidence: The concrete four-memory graph reports exactly five extracted links.

tests.name: tracks outgoing links
tests.evidence: Outgoing graph links are checked only for count two; wrong link targets or sources pass.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Replace each outgoing link pushed by buildLinkGraph with the same link whose target is WRONG.

tests.name: tracks backlinks (incoming)
tests.evidence: Auth backlinks contain exactly two links from literal DB Choice and Frontend Guide.

tests.name: identifies orphaned links

tests.name: handles memories with no links
tests.evidence: The concrete Three Layers memory has zero outgoing and one incoming link.

tests.name: handles empty memory list
tests.evidence: An empty input produces zero total links, no orphaned links and no graph nodes.

tests.name: returns backlinks for a target

tests.name: returns empty for memory with no backlinks
tests.evidence: A frontend memory with no backlinks returns an empty array.

tests.name: returns outgoing links for a source
tests.evidence: getOutgoingLinks checks only length two and never checks returned link targets.
tests.mutationSuggestion: Map returned getOutgoingLinks entries to copies with target=WRONG.

tests.name: returns empty for memory with no outgoing links
tests.evidence: A layers memory without outgoing links returns an empty array.

tests.name: produces a readable summary
tests.evidence: The rendered graph summary contains literal total=5, orphaned=1, Auth Decision and Nonexistent Memory.
